pages.text: $(thing)Tomato Mosaic$() ($(o)Tomato mosaic virus (Tobamovirus)$()), virus.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() tomato.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() mechanical contact, seedborne.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 15-32 °C (best 25 °C).

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 2 years (seed and residue).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 25% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Resistant varieties (Tm-2 genes); Wash hands and tools; Clean seed.$(br2)One of the most stable viruses known; survives for years in dried plant debris.
